$comment: Who is a tenant, in one place. clientNames: client ids. tenantFolders: each client's folder under src/data (and its client folder under src/markets). componentOwners: purpose folders under src/components that hold one client's own components. eslint.config.js (rule 9: shared code names no client) and scripts/standard-audit.mjs read this file; src/core/runtime/tenants.test.ts fails when a registered client, a data folder or a component folder is missing from it. npm run scaffold:client adds a new client here.
tenantFoldersComment: src/data holds exactly one folder per registered client, named after its id with '_' as '-' (the same name as its folder under src/markets).
componentOwnersComment: Components are filed by purpose, never by client (no folder under src/components is named after a client). A client's own components live in purpose folders it owns: folder (under src/components) → owning client. Lint, the standard audit, the catalog exporter and the scaffolds read this map; shared library folders are sharedComponentFolders.
